# BNDS_Not_Dating_Solo
This is a project allowing BNDS students NOT BEING SOLO! (For one day)

Not Dating Solo (NDS) is a web application that:
lets users register, log in, and maintain a profile
stores nickname, avatar, gender, gender preference, self-description, language
automatically pairs a user with another user into a temporary 1-day couple
provides a private chatroom for each active couple
allows text, image, and video messages inside the couple chatroom
supports English / Chinese language switching
includes Contact Us and Update Log pages
